taxon.wikipedia_summary: Moraea sisyrinchium (syn. Gynandriris sisyrinchium), the Barbary Nut, is a species of flowering plant, a dwarf iris, in the genus Moraea, native to southern Europe and the Mediterranean region.

page.title: Moraea sisyrinchium
page.extract: Moraea sisyrinchium, commonly the Barbary nut, is a species of flowering plant that belongs to the tribe Irideae. It is native to southern Europe and the Mediterranean region.
